quality.review_scope: Complete three-page main and identity-matched twenty-four-page SI independently source-audited. Cited full references remain unreviewed. Presentation refinements pending; no measured-coordinate admission.
missing_fields: Complete three-page main and identity-matched 24-page SI read textually and visually, including Figures 1–2, Schemes 1–3, SI Figures S1–S15, XPS table, QE equation and all 20 main/5 SI numbered references. Cited full papers unreviewed.

Core growth has a reported approximately 4 nm product at 315 °C for 7 min. The broader 3–6 nm family and 7–10 min interval do not define extra sample-specific experiments. Diameter measurement method, crystal polymorph, refined cell and atomic coordinates are unreported.
The core ODPA mass is printed as 0.6426 without a unit; the separately printed 1.921 mmol is preserved. The prepared Cd stock vial contains 1.065 g but the explicitly injected amount is 0.95 g.

Shell growth omits CdSe seed mass, sulfur-stock total delivered volume, addition duration, shell thickness and final particle diameter. No duration is calculated from a mass and volumetric rate without density.
Zn and sulfur stock mass/mmol pairs conflict; their printed values and later aliquot quantities are preserved without silent correction.

Only the SI core-shell chloride-exchange experiment has the specified 8.9 mg/stock-aliquot recipe. The similar bare-CdSe procedure does not establish identical absolute quantities. Other ligand treatments omit charges and some times/conditions.

Cleaning centrifugation force/time, final drying duration, several wash volumes/counts and precise ligand-exchange isolation details are unreported. The early insoluble hexane/acetone fraction is discarded, not the recovered nanocrystal product.

Surface Cd-rich X-type ligand coordination is the authors’ model from spectroscopy, not an atomic-coordinate measurement. Molecular model reactions, free reagents and analytical specimens remain separate supporting contexts.
Independent source comparison passed; molecular/particle/reference-cell presentation remains pending.
conflicts: SI p.4 prints diethylzinc 0.608 g, 0.492 mmol and bis(trimethylsilyl)sulfide 0.439 g, 0.246 mmol for 10 g stocks. SI pp.5–6 label their 1.0 g aliquots 0.492 mmol Zn and 0.246 mmol S. These internally inconsistent amount labels are retained literally.
Main p.2 cites Figure S9 for the 85%/15% surface composition; the actual annotated spectrum is SI p.16 Figure S8.
Main p.2 reports a 25% quantum-yield decrease for core-shell chloride exchange; the particular SI p.7 experiment reports 24.7% before and 20.1% after. Scope/normalization are not silently reconciled.

SI p.3 heading calls bis(trimethylsilyl)sulfide (5), while the main labels the silylated phosphonate ester 5. Main note15 also literally refers to addition of 5. Identities are not silently substituted.
SI p.3 textual model 31P peak14.18 and Figure S7 label14.19 differ in final digit. Figure S13 labels26.06/16.60 while main rounds26.1/16.6. Source precision is retained.
